intent: Six original contextual gap-building tasks plus a whole-story check require actual candidate placement, quoted clues on both sides, word-specific rejection and original reasoning. They preserve modest harvest, shared labour and problem solving. Fresh reading-corner transfer reverses both the lighting condition and connector relation, so copying dark/but fails.
picturePurpose: The exact code sentence is the visual model: every attempted candidate immediately changes the displayed meaning, with persistent wrong/correct states and removable placement. No decorative garden art is needed to infer the missing words.

workshop.title: 补全花园故事：让词和线索都对上
workshop.instruction: 先把候选词放进句子，再连接上下文核对；六空填过后，还要回看整篇故事。

items.material: Our school had a small empty space behind the dining hall. Last spring, our class decided to turn it into a ____. At first, we thought growing vegetables would be easy. We planted seeds and waited, ____ very little happened. Our science teacher asked us to check the soil and the light. We found that one corner was too ____. We moved some pots to a brighter place and made a watering plan. Everyone had a small job, so no one had to do ____ alone. A month later, the first leaves appeared. We did not grow much food that term, but we learned to ____ each other's work. Now, when a plant grows slowly, we look for a reason ____ giving up.

items.prompt: Did the class harvest a lot of food, and was that its only gain?

transfer.stem: Which pair fits both the lighting clue and the work-sharing result?
transfer.passage:
A FICTIONAL READING-CORNER PROJECT
Our club moved a reading corner into a room with large windows. Sunlight reached the tables, so the room was ____ (1), not short of light. We gave each member one small job: some moved books and others made signs. Everyone shared the work, ____ (2) nobody had to finish the whole project alone. The move did not make every book perfect, but it gave us a useful way to work together.

options.text: (1) bright; (2) so
(1) dark; (2) so
(1) bright; (2) but

explanation.strategy: 换了场景后重新找线索：不要照搬花园题的dark或but，要分别核对光照与因果。

steps.text: 大窗户的阳光照到桌面，而且not short of light排除缺光，所以第一空用bright。
steps.reason: 花园里因为后来移到更亮处才推回dark；这里直接给出充足光照，条件已经改变。

steps.text: 人人分工带来不必一人包办的结果，第二空用so。
steps.reason: 前后是合作与结果的顺接因果，没有预想与实际相反的转折。

distractors.reason: so正确表达分工的结果，但dark违背阳光照到桌面和不缺光这两条线索。
bright符合光照，却把合作的正常结果接成but转折；这里没有预期落差。

explanation.pitfall: 上一题的答案不是下一题的规则；光照和句间关系变了，选择也要跟着变。

visual.title: 条件改变，选择跟着改变
visual.caption: 每一空都回到新情境重新找证据，既核对意思，也核对前后逻辑。

explanation.transfer: 如果后来一句改成“我们虽然分了工，Ben却还是一个人全做完了”，连接关系会怎样变化？
